# Alban Pasquelin

> Alban Pasquelin is a freelance software architect and tech lead with twenty years of product engineering across web, mobile, desktop and embedded systems. Co-founder and CTO of GoSecure since 2017 and CTO of RetroRoads, he was the IPTV architect of MyTF1 at e-TF1 and the first head of the TV division at Molotov TV, winner of Apple App of the Year 2016.

I move critical products forward without stopping them: rebuilds, migrations, new screens, AI. I take the work from scoping through to production, and I use AI to deliver faster. Twenty years of experience, at TF1, Molotov, Ardian and in companies of my own.

Available for freelance work: Paris and Île-de-France, on site or hybrid, Rouen, French-speaking Switzerland, with Swiss invoicing, Remote across Europe.
Engagements: Tech lead or architect, time and materials; Fractional CTO; Audit and scoping, fixed price.
Contact: alban.pasquelin@gmail.com

## Experience

- [GoSecure · Co-founder and CTO (2017–present)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/gosecure/): Alban Pasquelin is co-founder and CTO of GoSecure, a public-safety platform in production since 2017 with companies, local authorities and transport operators, selected by the 2026 Propulse programme of the French Transport Innovation Agency.
- [RetroRoads · CTO (2026–present)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/retroroads/): Alban Pasquelin has been CTO of RetroRoads since May 2026, a consumer app for classic cars whose three parts he architected (a GraphQL API, an admin panel and an Expo mobile app), with content translated into twenty languages.
- [Ardian · React front-end developer on an internal tool rebuild (2025–2026)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/ardian/): Alban Pasquelin worked at Ardian from July 2025 to January 2026 on the rebuild of a strategic internal tool: stack and user-experience modernisation, a design system, and Figma implementation.
- [e-TF1 · Edito CMS rebuild lead (2024–2025)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/tf1-edito/): Alban Pasquelin led the rebuild of TF1's Edito CMS from January 2024 to July 2025, migrating the front end from Vue.js to React with end-to-end TypeScript, preserving data integrity throughout and cutting load times by more than 30%.
- [e-TF1 · IPTV architect for MyTF1 across all platforms (2021–2024)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/tf1-mytf1/): Alban Pasquelin was IPTV architect at e-TF1 from January 2021 to January 2024, rebuilding MyTF1 across every French operator set-top box from a single codebase (Android TV, WebOS and WPE), with SCTE-35 dynamic ad insertion integrated into the Freewheel stack.
- [Innso · Senior front-end developer (2019–2020)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/innso/): Alban Pasquelin was a senior front-end developer at Innso from March 2019 to December 2020, rebuilding the customer-relations platform and building a chatbot design studio.
- [Infopro Digital · Vue.js front-end developer, webinar platform (2018–2019)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/infopro-digital/): From December 2018 to March 2019, Alban Pasquelin designed and built a real-time webinar platform at Infopro Digital in Vue.js and OpenTok, which let the group bring the virtual events of its B2B media brands in-house.
- [Staffmatch · Angular front-end developer, back office (2018)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/staffmatch/): From February to December 2018, Alban Pasquelin led the Angular 5 development of the admin back office at Staffmatch, the platform matching companies with temporary staff.
- [Equidia · Angular front-end developer, via DonkeyCode (2017–2018)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/equidia/): From August 2017 to January 2018, for DonkeyCode, Alban Pasquelin led the complete rebuild of the Equidia TV website, France's reference channel for horse racing: front office and back office in Angular 5, on a PHP and Symfony API.
- [Arte · Apple TV app developer, via Hubee (2017)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/arte/): From September to December 2017, working through Hubee, Alban Pasquelin built and maintained Arte's Apple TV app, written in TVML and TVJS.
- [Amplement · R&D and product strategy director (2017)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/amplement/): Alban Pasquelin was R&D and product strategy director at Amplement from January to May 2017, leading a team of developers, designers and marketing specialists on the user-experience overhaul and the use of data.
- [Molotov TV · Head of TV division, then head of TV & product design advisor (2015–2016)](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/molotov/): Alban Pasquelin was the first head of the TV division at Molotov TV from February 2015 to December 2016, from the startup's early phase through to the launch of the service, which won Apple App of the Year 2016.
- [Business Lab · Lead developer, then technical project manager](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/experience/business-lab/): At Business Lab, Alban Pasquelin was lead developer and then technical project manager, heading a team of ten for Peugeot, Leroy Merlin and the E.Leclerc price comparator, winning two TOPCOM d'Or awards and the Grand prix Stratégies du digital.

## Projects

- [AI Desktop Studio](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/ai-desktop-studio/): AI Desktop Studio is a desktop generative creation studio built solo by Alban Pasquelin: 310 MCP actions across 26 families, seven workspaces covering image, video, 3D, audio, materials and skyboxes, in Electron, React 19, Three.js, PixiJS and SQLite.
- [Trillion3D](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/trillion3d/): Trillion3D is a real-time rendering engine for the web built by Alban Pasquelin: a native Rust compiler splits 3D models into clusters of 128 triangles, and a WebGPU engine in TypeScript, with a WebGL2 fallback, streams them under a fixed memory budget with GPU-driven culling, temporal antialiasing and dynamic lighting.
- [map3D](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/map3d/): map3D is a real-time 3D mapping library for React by Alban Pasquelin: a photorealistic globe on Google 3D Tiles down to street level, DOM markers and clusters, a geospatial drawing editor, an imperative Three.js engine under a declarative surface.
- [panels](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/panels/): panels is a React library by Alban Pasquelin providing the chassis of a tool application (icon rails, resizable zones, a free centre with draggable tabs) in 8 kB gzipped, with zero dependencies, MIT licensed.
- [media-studio](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/media-studio/): media-studio is a React Native and Expo SDK by Alban Pasquelin for photo and video capture, editing and export on iOS and Android: filters, animated text, stickers, transitions, a timeline and background export, with a fully headless core.
- [Enigma Cube](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/enigma-cube/): Enigma Cube is a WebGL puzzle role-playing game built by Alban Pasquelin with its own Three.js engine: hero, non-player characters and their behaviour, a level editor, a map editor and a bank of 43 3D models.
- [map3D plugins](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/map3d-plugins/): Alban Pasquelin's map3D plugins form a pnpm monorepo where each geographic data source (IGN, BD TOPO, Géoplateforme, webcams, Windy) becomes an independent package.
- [Fine-tuning local](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/projects/local-llm-finetuning/): Alban Pasquelin built a preparation and evaluation harness to specialise a multilingual Qwen model driving AI Desktop Studio, run locally on Apple Silicon inside Tart virtual machines.

## AI

- [Working with AI](https://www.pasquelin.com/en/ai/): Alban Pasquelin builds software that agents can drive: AI Desktop Studio exposes 310 actions over the MCP protocol across 26 families, and a specialised Qwen model executes them locally on Apple Silicon, measured by an automated evaluation harness.
